html_renders.html: Level up your OLED experience and leave distracting reflections behind with Glare Free technology. Self-illuminating pixels precisely control brightness, contrast and color on this thin, sleek TV. Video games become ultra-smooth up to 165Hz thanks to the Ultimate Gaming Pack and the AI-powered processor enhances shows and movies for phenomenal depth and vibrant detail.

OLED HDR+ with Glare Free

Experience incredible brightness and deep contrast for a lifelike picture. Powered by advanced AI, every detail is enhanced for stunning clarity. Glare Free technology lets you enjoy streaming and next-gen gaming without distractions, even in the brightest rooms.¹

NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor

Powered by 128 neural networks, this powerful 4K AI processor leverages AI to deliver a mind-blowing 4K TV experience. No matter what you enjoy watching—movies, shows, or sports— get it all upscaled to brilliant 4K, even if the source content isn't high-resolution, thanks to 4K AI Upscaling technology.² Plus, get sound optimized to the content you're watching for a truly immersive viewing experience.

Ultimate Gaming Pack

Conquer the competition with ultrasmooth, tear-free, low-latency gameplay and real-time responsiveness - all essentials for gamers who demand the best - enabled by the combination of superb motion clarity with Motion Xcelerator 165Hz and a stutter-free experience from NVIDIA G-SYNC or AMD FreeSync Premium Pro.³

4K AI Upscaling Pro

Watch shows, movies, games and more in stunning detail. Our AI processor upscales your content to up to impressive 4K resolution using 128 AI neural networks. Enjoy incredibly sharp and smooth picture quality, no matter what you watch.²

AI Motion Enhancer Pro

Keep up with all the fast-paced action of your favorite sport. The AI processor sharpens and smooths the motion of fast-moving balls and text by reducing blur and flickering.⁴ Whether it's a touchdown pass, a homerun, or the perfect drive in golf, the ball stays in clear view as it moves through the air: stats, scores, and news glide across the screen with improved legibility.

Auto HDR Remastering

Get the bold, dramatic picture of High Dynamic Range (HDR) even when watching Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) content. Auto HDR Remastering intelligently transforms SDR content to HDR-like quality with brighter highlights, more vibrant colors, and clearer details⁵ for dazzling picture using deep learning algorithms. SDR content is transformed by adjusting brightness, contrast, and color for HDR-like quality.

AI Sound Controller Pro

Effortlessly fine-tune your TV's audio. AI Sound Controller Pro classifies audio into three tracks—voice, background music and sound effects—and lets you adjust each independently with simple voice commands or an on-screen menu. Whether you want to amplify a show's dialogue, soften background music in a movie scene, or immerse yourself in your game's sound effects, it's all just a command away.⁶

Object Tracking Sound Lite and Dolby Atmos
